description: Every Belgian rail lookup the existing tools offer, plus transfer-risk, delay history and accessibility data that none of them have.

tools.name: board_list
tools.description: Live departures (or arrivals) at a station, with delay, platform and occupancy. Required: station. Optional: station-id, board-type (default: departure), alerts (default: false) (plus 3 more). Returns array of Departure.

params.name: station
params.description: Station name, e.g. Ghent-Sint-Pieters. Do not combine with --station-id

params.name: station-id
params.description: Station id (BE.NMBS.008892007) instead of a name. Do not combine with --station

params.name: board-type
params.description: Show the departures board or the arrivals board

params.name: alerts
params.description: Include railworks and service alerts announced for these trains

params.name: time
params.description: Time to query as hhmm (e.g. 1230). Defaults to now in Belgium

params.name: date
params.description: Date to query as ddmmyy (e.g. 300917). Defaults to today in Belgium

params.name: lang
params.description: Language for station and text fields

tools.name: disruptions_list
tools.description: Current disruptions and planned works across the whole network. Optional: line-break, lang (default: en). Returns array of Disturbance.

params.name: line-break
params.description: Sequence to use for line breaks in descriptions. Empty produces continuous text

params.name: lang
params.description: Language for station and text fields

tools.name: logs_list
tools.description: Last request log entries. Note: upstream currently returns an empty list; bulk archives live at gtfs.irail.be/logs/.

tools.name: route_plan
tools.description: Plan a journey between two stations, including transfers and per-leg delay. Required: from, to. Optional: time-basis (default: departure), transport (default: automatic), time (plus 2 more). Returns array of Connection.

params.name: from
params.description: Departure station name or id

params.name: to
params.description: Destination station name or id

params.name: time-basis
params.description: Whether --time means the departure time or the required arrival time

params.name: transport
params.description: Which services to consider. automatic allows international trains only for cross-border travel

params.name: time
params.description: Time to query as hhmm (e.g. 1230). Defaults to now in Belgium

params.name: date
params.description: Date to query as ddmmyy (e.g. 300917). Defaults to today in Belgium

params.name: lang
params.description: Language for station and text fields

tools.name: stations_list
tools.description: List every station iRail knows about (716 incl. cross-border). Optional: lang (default: en). Returns array of Station.

params.name: lang
params.description: Language for station and text fields

tools.name: train_composition
tools.description: Physical make-up of a train: segments, units, and per-carriage facilities. Required: id. Optional: fields, lang (default: en). Returns the Composition.

params.name: id
params.description: Train id, e.g. S51507 or IC1832

params.name: fields
params.description: Leave empty for iRail's curated stable fields, or 'all' for raw unfiltered NMBS data

params.name: lang
params.description: Language for station and text fields

tools.name: train_get
tools.description: Every stop of one train with live delay. Note: iRail ignores the date parameter. Required: id. Optional: date, alerts (default: false), lang (default: en). Returns the Vehicle.

params.name: id
params.description: Vehicle id, e.g. BE.NMBS.IC1832 or IC1832

params.name: date
params.description: Date as ddmmyy. Upstream currently ignores this and returns today

params.name: alerts
params.description: Include railworks and service alerts for this train

params.name: lang
params.description: Language for station and text fields
